name: Inoue Aoi
source:
Homeroom teacher of the main character's class.
She is mild-mannered, but she is a soft-spoken person who is weak in the face of pressure and tired of her teaching duties.

She already has a fiance, and she has been thinking of spending a safe life until her long-awaited retirement, so she has not been able to keep up with the current situation.
